problem_description: Compute the average temperature in K, pressure in bar, and density in kg/m^3 of a heptane liquid system. The system consisted of 361 heptane molecules in a cubic simulation box of dimensions 5.0 × 5.0 × 5.0 nm³ and was modeled using the gromos54a7_atb.ff force field. Energy minimization was performed using the steepest descent algorithm for 10000 steps with a step size of 0.002 nm. Molecular dynamics equilibration was performed in the NPT ensemble using the md integrator with a time step of 0.002 ps for 1000000 steps with neighbor list updates every 5 steps. Long-range electrostatic interactions were calculated using the Particle Mesh Ewald (PME) method with a real-space cutoff of 1.2 nm, while van der Waals interactions were treated using a cut-off scheme with a cutoff distance of 1.2 nm. All bonds should be constraints using the LINCS algorithm. Temperature coupling was applied with a coupling constant of 0.1 ps and a reference temperature of 298 K. Pressure coupling was applied with a coupling constant of 2.0 ps and a reference pressure of 1.0 bar. Production simulations were performed using the md integrator with a time step of 0.002 ps for 50000 steps using the same thermostat and barostat parameters.
